name: Barrel Dragon
source_text: Toss a coin 3 times. If 2 out of 3 results are Heads, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field. This card's effect can only be used during your own turn, once per turn.
notes: The target is selected before the coin toss; only a successful result destroys it.
